_about: SELECTION STUDIO · module library A (effects, entrances, backgrounds, emblems). Every file is a standalone live module: ?acc=<slug|hex> or postMessage({acc}) re-tints it, postMessage({cmd:'play'|'pause'}) runs or holds its loop (standalone pages play at once, embedded ones wait for play or ?play=1), postMessage({cmd:'replay'}) replays an entrance or steps a scene, and each module posts {pep:'ready', code, interact} to its parent. Scroll modules have their own internal scroller and, inside a tile (not in=stage), scrub themselves slowly when left alone. ?hint=0 / ?chrome=0 hide the corner hint / code tag; ?rm=1 forces the reduced-motion still. Shared runtime: _shared/fx-kit.css + fx-kit.js; 3D: _shared/type3d.mjs (brand type engine) + fx3d.mjs; assets: _assets/ (rebuilt by _build/build_assets.py). Serve over http(s): the 3D modules use ES modules.

modules.name: SCROLL-TO-SPIN EMBLEM
modules.desc: The real 3D PEPTICITY coin turns as you scroll, from edge-on to face-on through three short chapters, then lands flat with one sweep of light.
modules.source: APEX OBJ-08 Black-Chrome Monogram (owner pick: 'rotates as they scroll'); coin geometry from sites/dashboard-color startMark() via the brand type engine; BG-P01 smoke ground

modules.name: SIDEWAYS GALLERY
modules.desc: Scrolling down walks you sideways along a curved wall of five framed rooms from the PEPTICITY films; the frames lean with your speed and the middle one lights up.
modules.source: APEX SCR-04 Sideways Journey (horizontal pinned scroll), rebuilt for PEPTICITY with Higgsfield stills: city, doors, lab, case, vial

modules.name: FLIPBOOK SCRUB: THE CASE
modules.desc: The chest film plays frame by frame under your scroll: forward opens the case and the vial rises with the swirl, back closes it again.
modules.source: APEX library SCR-101 Flipbook Scrub (owner maybe-pick) on the Higgsfield chest film sites/main/media/chest-black.mp4 (121 frames)

modules.name: EXPLODED VIAL
modules.desc: The PEPTICITY vial comes apart in depth as you scroll: cap, crimp seal and glass separate, the lettering lifts off the label, and each part is named.
modules.source: APEX SCR-16 Exploded Layers (owner yes, 29 Oct) and sites/main/v2 exploded vial, on layers of the approved Higgsfield bottle brand/vial-hf

modules.name: MERCURY VIALS
modules.desc: Three PEPTICITY vials, one per way to belong: liquid silver rises inside each glass, and lifts higher when you point at one.
modules.source: APEX LAY-23 Mercury Vials (owner yes) and sites/main/v2 tiers, with the approved Higgsfield bottle

modules.name: WORD PORTAL FLY-THROUGH
modules.desc: Scroll flies the camera straight through the word PEPTICITY and down through the night city to the PEPTICITY doors.
modules.source: APEX SCR-17 Word Portal + SCR-07 Skyline Dive (owner yes) from sites/main/v2; Higgsfield city film frames (frames-hd black-weave) and the v2 door-sign plaque table

modules.name: SCROLL-LIT GLASS
modules.desc: See-through glass cards over moving silver smoke: each one catches the light as it reaches the middle of the screen and a streak runs round its edge.
modules.source: sites/dashboard-color card halos + light streak (30 Oct), BG-P01 smoke ground

modules.name: SCATTER ASSEMBLE IN 3D
modules.desc: Nine PEPTICITY letters in the approved 3D lettering tumble in front of a matte wall and fly together into the word as you scroll, shadows and all.
modules.source: APEX library TXT-104 Scatter Assemble, rebuilt in real 3D with brand/font/type3d-engine.js (PEPTICITY STUDIO look, wall scene from sites/brand-font)

modules.name: EARTH AND NETWORK
modules.desc: A lit earth turns with Canada facing you; PEPTICITY cities glow, linked by arcs of light. Point at a city and it lights every city it links to.
modules.source: APEX HOV-17 Wax Seal Atlas (owner yes: 'love the earth... nodes and edges') and sites/main/v2 gl3d.js earth + network; NASA public-domain textures

modules.name: GLASS MEMBER CARD
modules.desc: A thick frosted-glass PEPTICITY card in real 3D: it leans toward your pointer like a magnet, turns when you drag it, flips when you tap and engraves your name.
modules.source: APEX FRM-02 Live Member Card (owner yes, 29 Oct); sites/main/v2/card3d.js glass card with the approved P mark chip

modules.name: WINDOWS FROM EVERY ANGLE
modules.desc: The page arrives as glass windows flying in from every angle, from deep behind, the sides, above and below, and locks into the landing page.
modules.source: Owner's idea ('windows sliding in from different angles'), GSAP 3.15 timeline with Higgsfield stills

modules.name: THE DOORS OPEN
modules.desc: The site opens on the PEPTICITY doors: lights up, the plaque glows, a scan runs down the steel, the doors swing in and you walk through the light.
modules.source: sites/main/v2 scanner and doors (owner note: grand, top-secret doors), on the Higgsfield doors still; GSAP 3.15

modules.name: SCAN WIPE
modules.desc: How one page hands over to the next: a bright scan line runs down the screen with the new page above it and the old one dimming below.
modules.source: APEX TRN-03 Scan Wipe, turned into a page-to-page transition with Higgsfield stills

modules.name: TILE TO PAGE MORPH
modules.desc: Tap a tile and its picture grows into the full page while its title glides into place; back shrinks it home again.
modules.source: Browser View Transitions API (shared-element morph) with a Web Animations fallback; Higgsfield stills

modules.name: ARSENAL SMOKE
modules.desc: Liquid black-and-silver smoke that drifts slowly and ripples under your pointer, under a faint 30-degree chevron watermark.
modules.source: brand/ui/smoke-bg.js (BG-P01, the Arsenal and live-site ground) + the R093 30-degree watermark

modules.name: DASHBOARD SMOKE
modules.desc: Matte black meets UV black, silver smoke drifts through, a fine hexagon lattice floats in the middle and the nodes near your pointer light up and join.
modules.source: sites/dashboard-color ground: BG-P01 smoke + 30-degree lattice + the cursor tool's node light

modules.name: HELIX FIELD
modules.desc: The peptide swirl from the bottle as a slow field of bead helices floating in the dark, a few beads carrying your colour along the strands.
modules.source: New for the studio (three.js r160 points), after the peptide swirl on the approved bottle and the v2 member card etch

modules.name: MATTE WALL, LIGHT SWEEP
modules.desc: The matte gunmetal wall from your BLACK image with a slow gallery light sweeping across it and a second light that follows your pointer.
modules.source: Owner's BLACK image colours (wall #323232, brand/reference-kit), CSS only

modules.name: THE SPINNING COIN
modules.desc: The PEPTICITY coin turns slowly on display against the matte wall; it speeds up when you point, spins when you flick it and turns over when you tap.
modules.source: OBJ-08 emblem coin as built for the dashboards (sites/dashboard-color startMark) via the brand type engine

modules.name: THE 3D P
modules.desc: The approved PEPTICITY P in matte gunmetal stands off the wall with its shadow, leans toward your pointer and turns all the way round as you scroll.
modules.source: LOGO_P glyph (dashboard glyph table, approved P mark) extruded by brand/font/type3d-engine.js on the sites/brand-font wall

modules.name: RISING WORDMARK
modules.desc: Scroll to the foot of the page and PEPTICITY rises letter by letter out of a lit slot in the floor, then one band of light runs across it.
modules.source: APEX TXT-13 Rising Wordmark (owner yes) and the sites/main/v2 footer, in real 3D with the brand type engine
